S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  18.05.2023 AO No. 190 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Proposed Appeal has been filed by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 challenging the Award dated 15.02.2023, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ Vth Additional District Judge, Dehradun in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 155 of 2017, "Vipin Kumar and Another vs. Nutan Rajumani Transport Private Limited and Others", by which, a sum of Rs. 68,56,725/- (Rupees sixty eight lakh fifty six thousand seven hundred twenty five), as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of Petition till its actual payment has been awarded.
2.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 155 of 2017

entities.text: Vipin Kumar and Another vs. Nutan Rajumani Transport Private Limited and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, learned counsel for the appellant.

3. Admit.
4. Issue notice to respondent no. 1 and respondent no. 2-claimants.
5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6.

7. Heard on Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2023).
8.
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Advocate has sought six weeks' time to deposit the amount awarded before the Tribunal concerned 9.

Subject to deposit of amount awarded within six weeks from today before the Tribunal concerned,
the effect and operation of the Award dated 15.02.2023 are stayed till further order.
10. Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.
11. The said amount will be kept in the form of FDR in any nationalized bank.
